summary: Frontend-only test of Building Mutuality marketing site (15 routes). All routes load with no console errors. Navigation, mobile menu, FAQ accordion, About read-more toggle, Contact static form + success state, HI Accreditation structural distinctiveness (Coming Soon badge, 7 accreditation domains, Dignified Transition Test pull-quote), Speaking placeholder shell (video + placeholders + dual CTAs), and Explore Next / Footer blocks all verified. Responsive check at 390/768/1280 shows no horizontal overflow.

issues: H1 'The future of AI depends on human intelligence.' has very low contrast against the dark navy hero background — headline is barely legible in the initial viewport. Consider a lighter text color or a semi-transparent overlay behind the H1.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Improve contrast of Home hero H1 against dark background (currently near-invisible on load).
critical_code_review_comments: ScrollReveal defaults to opacity:0 which is intentional per brief, but ensure SEO-critical text (hero H1, testimonial names) remains accessible to crawlers — they do render server-side via React text nodes so this is fine.
Contact form uses native <select> for challenge dropdown (not shadcn Select) — works fine but inconsistent with rest of shadcn/ui usage.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 15 routes verified working. Contact form testids use kebab-case (input-first-name, input-last-name, etc.) — challenge dropdown is native <select>, use page.select_option(). Testimonials/HI content is below fold and gated by framer-motion whileInView (opacity 0 initially); must scroll (page.mouse.wheel) before reading textContent. HI page has exactly 7 domain h3 cards, coming-soon badge, and Dignified Transition Test pull-quote — structurally distinct from other service pages. Mobile menu links inside [data-testid='mobile-menu'] are plain <a> tags, not each labeled with a nav-link testid.
